data.body_html:
Imagine cruising the calm Mediterranean waters off Marbella, a glass of cava in hand, as a pod of wild dolphins arcs through the waves beside your boat. That's the reality of a dolphin watching brunch cruise Marbella 2026 — a family-friendly experience that combines wildlife spotting, coastal sightseeing, and a relaxed meal on the water. Departing from Puerto Banús, this 5-hour trip is perfect for families, couples, or small groups who want something more memorable than a standard boat hire.

Our fleet includes boats like the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, up to 9 guests) and the Azimut 39 (12.5m, up to 11 guests), both available from €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour charter. Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava), light snacks, insurance, and Spanish IVA. There are no hidden costs — just you, the sea, and the dolphins.

Why Choose a Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise in Marbella?

The Costa del Sol is one of Europe's best spots for dolphin watching. The Alboran Sea, just off Marbella, is home to common dolphins, bottlenose dolphins, and occasionally striped dolphins. Unlike crowded tourist boats, our private charters give you the freedom to linger where the dolphins are, with a skipper who knows the local waters intimately.

A brunch cruise adds a gourmet touch: enjoy fresh snacks and drinks while scanning the horizon. It's a far cry from a rushed sightseeing tour — here, the experience is as much about relaxing on the water as it is about wildlife.

What to Expect on Your Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise

Your trip begins at Puerto Banús, Marbella's iconic marina. After a brief safety briefing, you'll cruise westward along the coast, passing the Golden Mile, the Marbella Club Hotel, and the lush greenery of the Río Verde valley. The skipper will head to known dolphin feeding grounds, often near the mouth of the Guadalmina River or off Cabopino.

Dolphins are wild, so sightings are never guaranteed, but our skippers have a success rate well above 90% during the peak season (April–October). When a pod is spotted, the boat slows down or stops, giving you time to photograph and watch. The brunch — light snacks, fresh fruit, and drinks — is served as you drift.

After the wildlife encounter, you can continue to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a swim stop, or simply enjoy the return cruise with views of La Concha mountain.

Which Boat Is Best for Your Family?

For small families (up to 9 guests), the Astondoa 40 is an excellent choice — spacious, stable, and priced at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. The Azimut 39 (up to 11 guests) offers similar pricing and a sporty feel. If you have a larger group, the Mangusta 80 (up to 12 guests) starts at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter and includes a free jet ski for extra fun.

All boats depart from Puerto Banús and come with a full crew, so you can focus on the experience. Contact us via WhatsApp for availability and to discuss your ideal boat.

Best Time for Dolphin Watching in Marbella

Dolphins are resident in the Alboran Sea year-round, but the best visibility and calmest seas occur from April to October. Summer months (June–August) offer warm weather, long daylight hours, and the highest chance of sightings. Early morning departures (around 9:00–10:00) are ideal, as the sea is often glassy and dolphins are more active.

Winter trips are also possible, though sightings may be less frequent. Your skipper will always choose the best route based on real-time conditions.

What to Bring on Your Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise

  • Sunscreen and a hat (the Mediterranean sun is strong even in spring)
  • Sunglasses and a camera (waterproof recommended)
  • Swimwear and a towel (if you plan to swim)
  • A light jacket or windbreaker (sea breeze can be cool)
  • Your own snacks if you have specific dietary needs

The boat provides all drinks and light snacks. If you'd like a more substantial meal, we can arrange catering — just let us know when you book.

Book Your Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise Today

A dolphin watching brunch cruise Marbella 2026 is a unique way to experience the Costa del Sol with your family. Whether you're celebrating a birthday, an anniversary, or simply making memories, this private charter delivers wildlife, luxury, and relaxation in one unforgettable package.

To book, simply message us on WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and boat. We'll confirm availability and send you a secure payment link. Prices start at €749 for the Astondoa 40 (2 hours) — book early to secure your spot, especially during July and August.
